description: The line plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layers of a model for various KV cache compression strategies, with the x-axis representing five layer ranges—Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32—and the y-axis showing the relative change in performance as a percentage, ranging from -25% to 5%. The dashed gray line at 0% represents the baseline performance of a 4×tokens, 4-bit compression. The gold line with circular markers, labeled "LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit," starts at approximately -1% for Layer1-4, dips to around -3% at Layer5-12, rises to about -1% at Layer13-20, and then slightly increases to around -0.5% for Layer21-28 and Layer29-32. The red line with square markers, labeled "LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit," begins at approximately 0% for Layer1-4, decreases to about -5% at Layer5-12, rises to around -2% at Layer13-20, and then increases to about -1% for Layer21-28 and Layer29-32. The teal line with circular markers, labeled "RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit," starts at approximately -2% for Layer1-4, drops to around -12% at Layer13-20, and then increases to about -2% for Layer21-28 and Layer29-32. The dark blue line with square markers, labeled "RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit," begins at approximately -4% for Layer1-4, decreases to around -25% at Layer13-20, and then increases to about -5% for Layer21-28 and Layer29-32.
